setup.leadNoBusiness: Let's get your business ready to sell.
setup.guideLead: Finish these steps, one at a time.
setup.needsVenue: Add your venue first. A counter belongs to a venue.
setup.needsCounter: Set up a counter first. A device is paired to a counter.

business.title: Business details
business.body: Your business name, currency and time zone are saved. You can change them any time.
business.bodyTodo: Add your business name. Customers see it on their tickets.

venue.title: Add your venue
venue.body: Add the address and opening hours of the place where you sell.

catalog.title: Add what you sell
catalog.body: Add your first booking. Set a price and when people can come.

payments.title: Choose how you take payment
payments.body: Choose how customers pay you: cash, bKash or card.

counter.title: Set up a counter
counter.body: A counter is where you sell tickets. Give it a name and pick its venue.

team.title: Invite your team
team.body: Add the people who sell and check in customers. Each person gets their own PIN.

device.title: Connect a counter device
device.body: Link a tablet or phone to your counter so it can sell.

setup.readyBody: Your business is set up. Open the counter and make your first sale.
setup.readyBodySkipped: Your business is almost set up. You skipped {count} steps, and you can finish them later.
setup.tryBody: Make a practice sale and see how it works.
setup.pageBody: Let customers find you and book online. You can do this later.
setup.laterBody: You will see today's sales, places sold and who has arrived here.
